Name: (AT) Prophet's Rustic Farmhouse
Author: TheDeafProphet
Description:
[size=3]Salutations and long waited greetings my friends! It has been quite some time since I've last been modding, but nevertheless I have returned and I present to you: the farmhouse i was working on. I wanted something to use that really fit the "rustic cabin my grandfather left behind" vibes, so here we have it. I hope it brings you great joy to use. 

[b]How to use:[/b] Make sure you have both smapi and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]alternative textures[/url] installed. Then, in game go and acquire the Paint Bucket Tool from the carpenter shop. Using the paint bucket, you can then swap to this mod's building replacement. 

Update: I have made a content patcher version of this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34274]find it here![/url]


I chose to make this mod with alternative textures instead of content patcher, because I enjoy being able to easily switch back and forth between building mod options. This was my first time creating buildings so it was a fun excercise. Who knows I might make more.... if i don't get caught up with more furniture ideas now that i'm back ;) 

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/prophetmods.bsky.social]Come say hi on bluesky[/url] if you wanna see what I'm up to in the meantime! I'm a bit more responsive there

[/size]and if you would like to support me...

[/url]
Do not fret, my mods will ALWAYS be free, and are generally just me sharing things i make for myself. However, though they be a labour of love they are still a labour, and it'd be super awesome if anyone wanted to support the work I do ^^

Until next time~
